exact_statement: For every finite uniform cube, arbitrary Boolean G,H on the same physical data bits, and a fresh fair selector z, let F=(G+H)/2+z(G-H)/2, J=Pr(G!=H), e=GH, and L=H(F)-(H(G)+H(H))/2. Then 0<=L<=h2(J)+4J<=I(e)+4J. For every adaptive physical stopping tree the signed coherent debit equals L_root minus the reached live-terminal L values and is at most the ONE original allowance 4J_root+I(e_root)<=4I(F_root), retaining every inherited-core decrement and full actual terminal. This supplies no ownership across nested muxes. Indeed for complete quadratic Boolean f_n=(-1)^(sum_{i<j}x_i*x_j), even n>=2, the sum of newly supplied disagreement-influence tickets at all mux levels is n(n-1)/2, while I(f_n)=n/2, for any complete adaptive coordinate-order tree.
